fields.question: R3 says votes are anonymous but R4 says the organizer sees who voted for what. Which wins?
options: hidden from voters, visible to the organizer

choice: hidden from voters, visible to the organizer
rationale: Found in human review, not by a rule. The organizer needs names to place the order.

fields.text: A voter must not see how any other person voted.
Any team member can start a poll with 2 to 8 restaurant options.
A voter must be able to cast a vote in at most 2 taps from the poll link, in a phone or laptop browser.
The poll must close automatically 10 minutes after it opens, unless the organizer closes it sooner.
A voter can change their vote until the poll closes.
Results must appear within 2 seconds of the poll closing.
The tool must email every team member a reminder 2 minutes before the poll closes.
Every team member must get an email with the poll link when a poll opens.
When two or more places tie, the organizer must pick the winner from the tied places.
